title: Not Like Us, Hunty: Measuring Perceptions and Behavioral Effects of Minoritized Anthropomorphic Cues in LLMs
reasoning: The paper is an empirical user study focused on the impact of sociolects (AAE and Queer slang) on user reliance and perception. While it discusses ethical issues like cultural appropriation and linguistic bias, it does not evaluate or benchmark models on religious traditions, spiritual beliefs, or specific moral/ethical systems.
